slices.focus: Devon confronts Ariana about work occupying every room at home
slices.summary: Devon tells Ariana her archive work has taken over the house. They negotiate two archive-free evenings per week, no donor calls during band-concert nights, and a clear-dinner-table rule. The relationship emerges with firmer, healthier boundaries.
open_loops: Sustaining the two archive-free evenings per week consistently
Building a table-clearing ritual before protected evenings
Resetting expectations with work contacts about evening availability
